text: Single 'Pay & Transfer' hub spanning Zelle, Pay Bills, Transfer, Wire/ACH with consistent Activity view and demos for every rail [S001,S009,S014,S015]

Deepest virtual-assistant money movement among large banks: Erica can send/request Zelle, make recurring transfers, add payees, pay/cancel bills, send wires and check wire status, manage Zelle tags [S017,S003,S005,S020]

Layered Zelle controls: new-recipient OTP, 'You're authorizing a payment to someone new' interstitial, mandatory disclaimer acknowledgement, 60-day tenure gate on recurring, tenure-based limits, 'Pending review' holds, and explicit imposter-scam reimbursement language [S014,S002,S013]
No-fee foreign-currency international wires in 140+ currencies with a guided mobile flow and Reg E remittance cancel/refund rights [S005,S016]

Full, public explanation of Zelle payment states (Pending acceptance / Pending review / Paid; Scheduled → Processing → History) with Message Center guidance and email notices when the bank blocks or cancels a payment [S901,S013]
Parity web demos for Zelle send/receive exist (16-step and 8-step), with stronger web step-up (one-time code + debit card PIN) than mobile [S911,S912]
Deposit-hold disclosure is in-flow: mobile deposit confirmation screen, ATM screen/receipt and branch receipt all state the hold; later holds trigger an email alert [S903]
Fraud/scam claims are trackable in-app (Inbox > Status Tracker > View More Details) for consumer accounts [S915]
Scale: 25M active Zelle users, 1.8B transactions / $556B in 2025; small-business Zelle 200M payments / $126B; CashPro mobile approvals $1.2T [S921]

Commercial leadership: TCH co-owner, one of the first to enable $10M RTP, Recipient Select/Global Digital Disbursements with Zelle/Venmo/PayPal/Interac/Pay to Card, 100+ CashPro APIs, Coalition Greenwich No. 1 digital channels four years running [S025,S052,S053,S071,S049]
Senate PSI: BofA reimbursed 24% of Zelle scam disputes in 2023, an 'outlier' vs 2% (Chase) and 4% (Wells Fargo); BofA testified it reimbursed imposter scams before the 2023 network rule [S961][S962].
Bank-stated pre-send controls: new-recipient 'speed bump', high-risk transfers cancelled unless customer affirmatively confirms [S962].
No FedNow participation as of late 2025 (one of two top-8 holdouts) [S030,S031]
Consumer external-transfer (ACH) base limits are low ($1,000 per transaction) and no Same Day ACH option; external transfers are buried under the 'Wire/ACH' label [S013,S016]
Zelle request/split and QR are mobile-only; web lacks request/split [S002]
Secured Transfer requires debit card number + PIN + mobile OTP (or USB key) – a hard dependency for wires/ACH [S005,S015,S016]

No documented dual-approval/dual-control for small business payments in Business Advantage 360; SMB limited to $5,000 ACH/wire base limits; legacy Direct Payments and Payments & Invoicing closed [S021,S013]
Bill Pay cancellation window (5 p.m. ET three business days before delivery) is restrictive; AutoPay requires eBills [S013,S010]
Consumer RTP 'Request for Payment' exists only in legal terms with no visible UI/marketing [S013]
Business account fraud claims are not viewable in the in-app Status Tracker [S915]
Remote Deposit Online supports a single User ID (sub-user deposits under the owner's ID) and does not verify funds at capture [S924]
No self-service cancel for a submitted domestic wire is documented; only Remittance Transfers have the 30-minute cancel [S005,S916]
No Zelle accounting-software integration for small business ('does not currently integrate directly with accounting software') [S901]

Payment-purpose prompts / recipient-specific risk warnings in the 2025–26 Zelle flow are not described anywhere public; only the generic 'authorizing a payment to someone new' pop-up and static scam block are documented [S911,S002]

Zelle scam intake runs through Online Banking or phone (via the Security Center page). No mobile in-app scam-report path is documented, and reimbursement criteria remain 'qualifying imposter scams' [S037,S901,S915]

Mobile deposit exceptions (e.g., potential fraud, insufficient funds on the check) are communicated by postal letter asking the customer to bring the check to a financial center. Holds are shown on the confirmation screen or by email alert [S006,S903]

No public documentation of dual approval or per-user limits for Business Advantage 360 core payments. The sub-user demo shows only view/transact toggles and Full/Limited Bill Pay access. An approval role existed only in the legacy Payments and Invoicing (Bill.com) service, closed to new enrollment [S906,S021] (INFERRED)
PSI: BofA policy treats a review of its own records as sufficient to deny a Zelle claim when funds went to an account outside BofA [S961].
EWS assessed BofA a $30,000 network noncompliance fee in Sept 2023 (PSI p. 7) [S961].
CFPB complaint (Dec 2024; allegation, dismissed Mar 2025) attributed ~$290M of losses across ~210,000 BofA customers [S963].
Warren 2022 (2021–H1 2022): BofA refunded about 45% of the dollar value of reported unauthorized Zelle transfers ($56.1M of $125M) [S966].
Erica-initiated wires and Zelle (voice/text) [S005,S017]
Zelle tags + printable QR for small business point-of-sale acceptance [S020]
Single-use virtual card as a Bill Pay electronic delivery method [S013]
International wire session shows an estimated FX rate held for 10 minutes [S016]
Blended Zelle recipient list routes BofA-to-BofA payments as internal transfers (BofA logo vs purple Z) [S002]
Recipient Select 'Pay to Card' push-to-card and Interac 'Request for Pay' for corporates [S053,S052]
Temporary higher Zelle limits to select recipients surfaced inside the pay flow ('When eligible, you will be informed of the approved amount within the pay flow') [S901]
Small-business Zelle tags + QR codes launched late 2025 (6–40 char tags; up to 5 tokens incl. tags) [S901,S921]

Help Center/online banking exposes third-party ACH push by account number ('Transfer money to an account outside the bank… using his or her account number') alongside own-account external transfers [S916]
Mar 12 2026: first-of-its-kind Zelle DAF grant-disbursement proof of concept via BofA Charitable Gift Fund (limited pilot, part of the Zelle Forward innovation agenda) [S922]
Mar 4 2025: CFPB dropped (with prejudice) its Dec 2024 Zelle suit naming BofA (alleged $290M losses, 210k customers) [S026]
Jun 10 2025: BofA among first to enable $10M RTP limit; 32% RTP volume growth in six weeks [S025]
Late Oct 2025: BofA confirms it has still not joined FedNow [S030]
Dec 2025 (app 25.12.0): copy/paste of Bill Pay payee details; Oct 2026 (26.10.x): refreshed Erica experience and app design [S032]
Jan 2026: press reports BofA shows multiple scam pop-ups before Zelle payments complete [S023]
Paze enabled on all eligible BofA credit/debit cards (rolled out from summer 2024) [S036,S060]
Nacha 2026 fraud-monitoring rules timeline published on BofA ACH page [S054]
Nov 5 2026 (iOS 26.11.0) and Nov 3 2026 (Android): app-wide look-and-feel refresh following the Oct 2026 Erica refresh (26.10.02–26.10.06) [S918,S919]
Jul 1 2026 (26.07.0): 'Simplify login by confirming your identity on your mobile device, reducing the need for one-time passcodes'; BofA Rewards loyalty program [S918]
Feb–Mar 2026 (26.02.02/26.03.0): in-app identity confirmation for adding cards to digital wallets; copy/paste support for mobile check deposit details and confirmation numbers [S918]
Jan 15 2026 (26.01.0): copy/paste of Bill Pay payee details and account numbers [S918]
Mar 10 2026: BofA reports 25M active Zelle users, $556B Zelle volume (2025), SB QR codes + Zelle tags launched late 2025, CashPro mobile approvals $1.2T [S921]
Mar 12 2026: Zelle + BofA Charitable Gift Fund DAF grant-disbursement pilot (Zelle Forward) [S922]
Oct 6 2026: expanded small-business fraud education (Fraud Prevention Checklist, BEC webinar, CashPro webinars, Security Meter) – no new payment controls [S923]
Nov 2 2026: Federal Reserve FedNow participant list still excludes Bank of America [S917]

Jun 4 2026: BofA announced cross-border real-time payments (SPEI Mexico, FPS UK, UPI India; inbound real-time to U.S.) via Swift/CashPro, expected Q3 2026; Sep 29 2026: first pilot payment with Bradesco (Brazil→Hong Kong FPS); CashPro availability to follow [S027,S951,S952]
Mar 31 2025: Zelle standalone app retired (network-wide; reported by press and zelle.com). BofA directs users to Zelle inside its own app/Online Banking [S057,S002]

Mar 2025 CFPB suit dismissed with prejudice; Jul 2025 congressional letter on social-media scams (no response located); Jul 2026 NY AG v. EWS survives dismissal (BofA named only as owner) [S963][S964][S967].
Nacha Phase 1/2 fraud-monitoring rules effective Mar 20 / Jun 19, 2026 [S969].

Domestic wire cancellation/recall self-service rules (no public cancel path beyond Remittance Transfers' 30 minutes) [S005,S916]
